coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Three of six ground-truth variable categories are substantially represented: Docta label cleaning, raw versus Docta-cleaned training data, and F1-based predictive performance measurement.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output substitutes Banking77, AG News, IMDb, and SST-2 for the fixed Anthropic Harmless and Red Team datasets, and RoBERTa/DeBERTa for BERT/GPT-2. It does not evaluate model performance on the specified ChatGPT Cleaned and Human Sampled test subsets; human and ChatGPT judgments instead serve a separate label-preference experiment. Its F1 measurement is not specifically for toxicity classification, and it adds numerous unsupported conditions and metrics.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: The output omits the expected significantly higher F1-scores from Docta-cleaned training on both specified test subsets and the resulting validation of improved label credibility through reduced label inconsistencies.
